mentions.name: CineSignal
mentions.description: CineSignal is a filmmaker community where actors, writers, and directors can showcase their work and represent themselves online. It aims to replace personal Squarespace sites (filmmakers don't want to be webmasters), ad-heavy IMDB profiles, and the dated Actor's Access, with a human-first, AI-optional approach.
mentions.problem: Filmmakers each maintain their own Squarespace site though almost none want to be webmasters, while existing options like IMDB are full of ads and Actor's Access is ancient.
mentions.audience: actors, writers, and directors looking to represent themselves online
mentions.source_excerpt: A filmmaker community for those wanting to showcase their work. Right now everyone's got their own squarespace and the problem is that about 0 filmmakers also want to be web masters.

evidence.value: A filmmaker community for those wanting to showcase their work. Right now everyone's got their own squarespace and the problem is that about 0 filmmakers also want to be web masters.

mentions.name: CineSignal
mentions.description: A portfolio and showcase platform for film-industry creatives. It hosts headshots, resumes, and reels, lets users upload screenplays that can be read aloud, and provides a place to share cinematic music scores, positioning itself as an alternative to LinkedIn, Actors Access, and generic website builders.
mentions.problem: LinkedIn isn't for creatives, Actor's Access is dated and charges a lot for basic extras, and Squarespace/Wix sites are siloed and unwanted to maintain.
mentions.audience: Film-industry creatives such as actors, screenwriters, and composers looking to showcase their work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a site for filmmakers to help showcase themselves!

Why? >

LinkedIn isn't for creatives. 
Actor's Access is dated and charges a ton for basic extras
Squarespace/wix is fine but everyone in 'the biz' has one and nobody wants to maintain it. Plus they're all silo'd.

Check out my site if you wanna. You get to host your own headshots, resume, and reels. You can upload your screenplay there and hear it read outloud. You can put up your cinematic scores and make a place to send people to hear your music.

https://cinesignal.com
